stories.title: 幣安遭史上最大約 63 億美元盜竊；承諾全數賠償
stories.title_en: Binance Hit by Record $6.3 Billion Crypto Theft
stories.summary: 10/29 約 20 分鐘內熱錢包被盜，疑北韓集團；幣安以 SAFU／儲備覆蓋用戶損失並凍結約 30 億美元。
stories.summary_en: The breach on October 29 drained hot wallets across chains in ~20 minutes; Binance pledged full coverage via SAFU/reserves and froze ~$3B on-chain.
stories.why_it_matters: 交易所被盜會短暫壓抑風險偏好；紙上倉宜收緊止蝕，留意提款／穩定幣凍結連鎖反應。

stories.title: Trezor 警告：印尼經銷商 CryptoBilis 或售出被植入硬體
stories.title_en: Trezor Warns CryptoBilis Buyers of Possible Hardware Tampering
stories.summary: Safe 5 疑被加裝可經流動網絡傳種子板；3 月起於該店購買者應即換新錢包並轉移資產。
stories.summary_en: A tampered Safe 5 from CryptoBilis (Tokopedia) may capture seed phrases; buyers since March should create a fresh wallet and move funds.
stories.why_it_matters: 供應鏈植入直接威脅冷錢包；自管資產要驗證來源，唔好用非官方經銷商。

stories.title: Chainalysis 通知客戶：系統曾遭未授權存取
stories.title_en: Chainalysis Notifies Customers After Unauthorized System Access
stories.summary: 入侵者接觸非敏感聯絡資料；公司稱未見調查檔／密碼外洩，提醒提防釣魚。
stories.summary_en: An actor accessed non-sensitive contact data; no evidence investigation files or credentials were taken; watch for phishing.
stories.why_it_matters: 合規／追蹤基建出事會影響機構風控同執法節奏，短線情緒偏謹慎。

stories.title: Aave 於幣安被盜後重開借貸市場
stories.title_en: Aave Reopens Lending Markets After Binance Breach Freeze
stories.summary: 曾預防性凍結多鏈儲備；提款／還款一直可用，現分階段重開，部分 USDT 仍設限。
stories.summary_en: Aave froze reserves as precaution after ~$60M USDT hit V3; withdrawals continued; markets reopening in stages with some USDT limits.
stories.why_it_matters: DeFi 風控工具（凍結 vs 隔離市場）會影響借貸流動性同穩定幣溢價。

stories.title: Polymarket 因第三方腳本被駭暫停約一小時；賠償約 390 萬美元
stories.title_en: Polymarket Halts Trading After Third-Party Hack Drains $2.7 Million
stories.summary: DebugBear 監控腳本被注入，約 726 名用戶被盜；平台退款並額外補償交易損失。
stories.summary_en: Injected third-party monitoring script drained ~$2.7M; Polymarket refunded users and added trading-loss compensation (~$3.9M total).
stories.why_it_matters: 預測市場／前端第三方 JS 風險上升；同類型站點要收緊腳本權限。

stories.title: Druckenmiller 撐 trade[XYZ]；ICE×Hyperliquid 擬推美國永續期貨
stories.title_en: Stan Druckenmiller Backs trade[XYZ] in ICE-Hyperliquid U.S. Futures Deal
stories.summary: ICE 與 trade[XYZ]、Hyperliquid 合作待 CFTC 批；消息後 HYPE 一度升逾一成。
stories.summary_en: ICE partnered with trade[XYZ]/Hyperliquid for regulated 24/7 perps pending CFTC; HYPE jumped >10% on the news.
stories.why_it_matters: 傳統交易所入場永續會改變 HYPE／流動性敘事；急升板留意事件驅動回吐。

stories.title: Strategy（MSTR）改以優先股籌資買 BTC；普通股稀釋受控
stories.title_en: Strategy Details Preferred Stock Shift for Bitcoin Buys Amid Earnings Volatility
stories.summary: Q3 稱主要發 STRC 等數碼信貸買幣；持約 84.8 萬 BTC，股價伴隨波動。
stories.summary_en: Strategy will mainly issue preferred (e.g. STRC) to fund BTC buys; holds ~848k BTC; shares volatile around earnings.
stories.why_it_matters: BTC 代理股融資結構影響槓桿買盤預期，短線聯動 BTC 波動。

stories.title: MSTR 跌約 9%；交易員大舉買 Put 押再跌
stories.title_en: Traders Bet Big on MicroStrategy Puts as Stock Drops 9%
stories.summary: 股價跌至約 $129，期權溢價急升；背景包括大盤同交易所被盜情緒。
stories.summary_en: MSTR slid ~9% near $129 as put premiums spiked amid crypto weakness and exchange-hack nerves.
stories.why_it_matters: 事件驅動槓桿押注會放大 BTC／代理股波動，紙上倉宜控倉。

stories.title: 交易員 Frank 平倉逾千萬美元 Memecoin 相關空單
stories.title_en: Crypto Trader Frank Closes Million-Dollar Memecoin Shorts
stories.summary: 平掉 BTC／ZEC／NEAR／PUMP 等約 $1230 萬槓桿空倉；指 meme 總市值由高峰大幅回落。
stories.summary_en: Closed ~$12.3M leveraged shorts on BTC/ZEC/NEAR/PUMP after profits; notes memecoin market cooled vs 2024 peaks.
stories.why_it_matters: 大戶平倉訊號反映 meme 板塊冷卻；急升板要更嚴進出場。

stories.title: Ansem 於 Pumpfun 永續開大額 SOL 空；$ANSEM 已回撤約 88%
stories.title_en: Ansem Opens Big SOL Short on Pumpfun as $ANSEM Memecoin Drops 88%
stories.summary: 約 $88 萬 10x SOL 空單；同名 meme 由高峰大跌，社群質疑空投進度。
stories.summary_en: Opened ~$880k 10x SOL short on Pumpfun perps; $ANSEM down ~88% from peak amid airdrop questions.
stories.why_it_matters: 網紅槓桿方向會帶動短線情緒；SOL／相關 meme 波動加大。

stories.title: SPX6900 靠社區死守市值約 3.4 億；持續 DCA 買入
stories.title_en: SPX6900 Memecoin Thrives on Relentless Community Positivity
stories.summary: 無團隊路線圖，靠口號同聚會撐住；近日有大額現貨買入同持續小額定投。
stories.summary_en: No team/roadmap community coin near ~$340M; holders DCA and spot buys keep narrative alive.
stories.why_it_matters: 社區敘事幣在弱市仍吸金，但回撤深；急升板要分清炒作同可持續流動。

stories.title: Coinbase Q3 淨利約 7.19 億美元；BTC 庫存續增
stories.title_en: Coinbase Reports $719 Million Q3 Profit with Bitcoin Treasury Growth
stories.summary: 利潤多來自加密資產未實現收益；訂閱／預測市場增長，交易收入回落。
stories.summary_en: Q3 net income ~$719M largely from unrealized crypto gains; subscriptions/prediction markets up, trading revenue softer.
stories.why_it_matters: 交易所盈利結構轉訂閱／預測市場，反映現貨交易量偏弱。

stories.title: 幣安被盜後網民玩梗：叫駭客下一步去 Pump.fun
stories.title_en: Crypto Users Urge Binance Hackers to Target Pump.fun
stories.summary: 諷刺帖湧現，指向 rug／bot 怨氣；同時凸顯 CEX 與發射台風險不對稱。
stories.summary_en: Satirical posts joked about directing hackers at Pump.fun amid rug/bot frustration after the Binance breach.
stories.why_it_matters: 情緒指標顯示發射台信任仍低；紙上追 meme 要更嚴過濾洗版。

stories.title: Solana 開發者因逆向 Pump.fun 合約收到律師信
stories.title_en: Solana Developer Faces Cease-and-Desist for Reverse-Engineering Pump.fun Contracts
stories.summary: Shaw 公開 C&D；辯稱字節碼在鏈上公開，促開源以降低用戶風險。
stories.summary_en: Shaw shared a C&D after reverse-engineering Pump.fun contracts; argues public bytecode and security need for open source.
stories.why_it_matters: 閉源發射台爭議升溫，影響 Solana meme 基建信任同合規風險定價。

stories.title: 香港持牌穩定幣 HKDAP 登陸 Solana
stories.title_en: Anchorpoint Brings HKD Stablecoin HKDAP to Solana Blockchain
stories.summary: Anchorpoint（渣打香港／HKT／Animoca 背景）將 HKDAP 由以太坊擴至 Solana。
stories.summary_en: HKMA-licensed Anchorpoint expands HKDAP mint/redeem from Ethereum beta onto Solana for faster Asian settlements.
stories.why_it_matters: 非美元穩定幣上 Solana 利好亞洲支付／RWA 敘事，中長線基建利好。

stories.title: Solana RWA 規模突破約 51.9 億美元；Polygon 打通資金棧
stories.title_en: Solana RWA Value Tops $5 Billion with Polygon Integration
stories.summary: 代幣化資產創新高；Polygon Open Money Stack 接入 Solana 方便跨鏈支付。
stories.summary_en: Solana RWA hit ~$5.19B ATH; Polygon Open Money Stack adds Solana for multi-chain deposits/stablecoin payouts.
stories.why_it_matters: RWA 增長支撐 SOL 基本面敘事，與純 meme 熱度形成對照。

stories.title: 神秘巨鯨五日拋售逾 104 萬 SOL（約 1.04 億美元）
stories.title_en: Mysterious Whale Dumps $104 Million in Solana Tokens
stories.summary: 轉入 Gate／Kraken 等；SOL 測試約 $100 支撐，同時生態 RWA／交易量仍高。
stories.summary_en: Whale sold >1.02M SOL (~$104M) into exchanges over 5 days; SOL tests ~$100 while RWA/activity stay strong.
stories.why_it_matters: 供應壓力壓抑 SOL 短線；急升山寨要睇大盤會唔會跟住縮量。

stories.title: Monad 發布 OpSec 指南同 Ultrafuzz 對抗 AI 攻擊
stories.title_en: Monad Shares Security Tools and Guides Against AI-Powered Crypto Threats
stories.summary: 強調社工劫持損失遠超合約漏洞；開源模糊測試工具協助專案自查。
stories.summary_en: Released Crypto OpSec Bible + Ultrafuzz; notes social-engineering losses dwarf smart-contract bugs.
stories.why_it_matters: AI 社工／供應鏈攻擊升溫，專案同用戶都要升級金鑰同裝置管理。

stories.title: Shopify 商戶經 Coinbase 協議已結算約 4200 萬美元 USDC
stories.title_en: Shopify Merchants Settle $42 Million in USDC Payments via Coinbase Protocol
stories.summary: Base 上開源支付協議；買家用錢包結帳、商戶可定期轉法幣。
stories.summary_en: Shopify+Coinbase Commerce Payments Protocol on Base settled ~$42M USDC across 448k payments.
stories.why_it_matters: 穩定幣走進日常結帳，屬中長線採用利好，短線對 meme 影響有限。

stories.title: 比特幣主導率回落約 60%；有人喊資金輪動山寨
stories.title_en: Bitcoin Dominance Dips as Altcoins Show Signs of Surge
stories.summary: BTC.D 約 60.1%，山寨主導圖現 MACD 轉強聲浪；altseason 指數仍中性。
stories.summary_en: BTC dominance ~60.1% with talk of rotation; altseason index still neutral ~56–59.
stories.why_it_matters: 若真輪動，急升板機會增；但弱市假突破多，仍要用出場規則。

stories.title: Coinbase 上架 Ripple RLUSD 穩定幣供美國用戶
stories.title_en: Coinbase Lists Ripple's RLUSD Stablecoin for U.S. Users
stories.summary: 零售／交易所／Prime 可兌換；RLUSD 市值約 26 億，近 90 日淨流入逾 10 億。
stories.summary_en: Coinbase listed RLUSD across app/exchange/Prime; ~$2.6B market cap with >$1B net inflows in 90 days.
stories.why_it_matters: 機構級穩定幣通路擴大，利好法幣進出效率，短線對 meme 影響有限。

stories.title: 代幣化股票市值約 46.3 億美元；對標早期穩定幣曲線
stories.title_en: Tokenized Stocks Hit $4.63 Billion Milestone Echoing Early Stablecoins
stories.summary: Binance bStocks、Ondo、xStocks 佔大頭；BNB Chain 領先，DTCC 鏈上服務亦推進。
stories.summary_en: Tokenized stocks ~$4.63B; Binance bStocks/Ondo/xStocks dominate; BNB Chain leads value hosted.
stories.why_it_matters: 幣安生態代幣化股票增長，同本站排除代幣化股票做 gainer 宇宙有關。

stories.title: 新加坡警籲查假 Ledger：零售店被改機損失約 270 萬美元
stories.title_en: Singapore Police Warn of Tampered Ledger Wallets in Retail Stores
stories.summary: 至少兩宗受害者；惡意元件偷種子。官方建議直接向原廠購買並核對包裝。
stories.summary_en: At least two victims lost funds via tampered Ledger devices in retail; buy direct and verify packaging.
stories.why_it_matters: 硬體錢包供應鏈攻擊在東南亞擴散，自管資產要驗證裝置。

stories.title: Murad：AGI 時代社區 Memecoin 或跑贏工具幣
stories.title_en: Memecoins Seen Outlasting Utility Tokens in AGI Era
stories.summary: 指文化／聚會難被 AI 複製；同時提醒大多數 meme 終會歸零。
stories.summary_en: Murad argues community memecoins outlast utility tokens once AGI commoditizes code; skeptics note most memes still die.
stories.why_it_matters: 敘事面支撐高風險追漲情緒，但唔改變多數發射幣歸零嘅基本盤。

stories.title: CFTC 主席想像雪櫃代炒幣買菜：AI 代理人監管成焦點
stories.title_en: CFTC Chair Envisions Fridge Trading Crypto for Groceries
stories.summary: Frontier Forum 提出 know-your-agent 等問題；AI 可持倉、交易甚至發 meme。
stories.summary_en: CFTC Chair Selig flagged autonomous AI agents trading crypto/memecoins and asked who registers/liability rules.
stories.why_it_matters: 監管開始對 AI 交易代理人定調，中長線影響自動化交易合規成本。
